tickerText: [TENNIS] Defending champion Italy reached a fourth straight Davis Cup final after Lorenzo Musetti and Andrea Vavassori edged Czechia in Bologna while Spain and Great Britain contest the other semifinal with Carlos Alcaraz in singles • [SQUASH] The PSA Platinum Milwaukee Hong Kong Squash Open begins November 30 with World No. 1 Amina Orfi, Mostafa Asal and Paul Coll headlining 64-player draws across Edinburgh Place • [BADMINTON] BWF confirmed Mississauga for the 2027 Worlds, New Delhi and Paris for future Thomas & Uber Cups and locked the top eight for December's $3.5M Hangzhou World Tour Finals • [PICKLEBALL] The Opendoor World Championships set PPA attendance and revenue records at 70,000 fans and Judit Castillo won women's singles at the Proton Daytona Beach Open • [TABLE TENNIS] Shunsuke Togami and Honoka Hashimoto clinched the final WTT Finals Hong Kong singles spots in Muscat as Olympic champions Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha received the mixed-doubles wildcard for Kai Tak December 9–13

newsItems.title: BWF Through 2030
newsItems.excerpt: BWF awarded the 2027 World Championships to Mississauga, Thomas & Uber Finals to New Delhi in 2028 and Paris in 2030, and approved 24-team league-and-knockout formats from 2028.

newsItems.title: Finals Field Set
newsItems.excerpt: Muscat champions Shunsuke Togami and Honoka Hashimoto took the last men's and women's singles berths for WTT Finals Hong Kong; Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha received the lone mixed-doubles wildcard.

newsItems.title: Italy Four-Peat Bid
newsItems.excerpt: Lorenzo Musetti beat Jakub Mensik and Italy's doubles pair clinched a 2–1 semifinal win over Czechia, sending the three-time champions into Sunday's Davis Cup final in Bologna.

newsItems.title: Castillo Takes Daytona
newsItems.excerpt: Judit Castillo lifted her second U.S. PPA singles title with a 12–10, 11–2 win over Kiora Kunimoto at the Proton Daytona Beach Open after Anna Leigh Waters sat out women's singles.
